pages.title: Uchigatana
pages.text: Uchigatana-type Touken Danshi. Touken Danshi of the same blade type share virtually identical attack speed, detection range, attack power, and movement speed.

pages.name: Kashuu Kiyomitsu
pages.text: An uchigatana once used by Okita Souji of the Shinsengumi.Having come from an impoverished background, he believes that dressing up prettily will earn him his master's affection.He and Yamatonokami Yasusada are quarrelsome partners who appear to be complete opposites yet share remarkably similar personalities.

pages.name: Kasen Kanesada
pages.text: An uchigatana named after the Thirty-Six Poetic Immortals, inspired by his former master Hosokawa Tadaoki's slaying of 36 retainers.He merely claims to be the cultured type.

pages.name: Yamanbagiri Kunihiro
pages.text: An uchigatana believed to have been forged in imitation of the sacred blade "Yamanbagiri."He harbors complicated feelings about not being the original.He detests being called beautiful and deliberately dresses himself in shabby attire.Though formidable in strength, he tends to overthink things and get himself tangled up in knots.

pages.name: Mutsunokami Yoshiyuki
pages.text: An uchigatana that served as the personal blade of Sakamoto Ryouma.Though his rustic nature is unavoidable, he is quite fond of new things.He is utterly sincere about both his own ambitions and his loyalty to his master.

pages.name: Hachisuka Kotetsu
pages.text: An authentic uchigatana crafted by the Edo-period swordsmith Kotetsu.His elder brother Nagasone Kotetsu dotes on their younger brother Urashima Kotetsu, yet harbors a particular disdain for forgeries.

pages.name: Heshikiri Hasebe
pages.text: An uchigatana made by Hasebe Kunishige. Its name comes from the story of Nobunaga using this blade to cut down a tea master hiding under a serving table, along with the table itself. He is loyal to his master and longs to be the first retainer, though he never says it aloud. Even foul tasks are carried out calmly.

pages.name: Yamatonokami Yasusada
pages.text: An uchigatana said to have been used by Okita Souji of the Shinsengumi. Like Kashuu Kiyomitsu, it is difficult to handle and picks its wielder. It is said to have been cheap for that reason. Though he appears gentle and mature, when it comes to battle...

pages.name: Yamanbagiri Chogi
pages.text: An uchigatana made by Chogi of Bizen Osafune. Chogi was a smith who differed from the mainstream Osafune school, developing his own style. He is said to be on par with the imitation Yamanbagiri Kunihiro. Beautiful and proud—more precisely, he has confidence in himself and fears nothing.

pages.name: Ookurikara
pages.text: An uchigatana forged by Hiromitsu of the Soshu-den tradition. Because it was passed down in the Date clan, he is an old friend of Shokudaikiri Mitsutada, Daitokuji Sadamune, and Tsurumaru Kuninaga. However, he is a loner who dislikes interacting with others. He bears a carving of Kurikara, the dragon king, which is the manifestation of Fudo Myoo.
